hook.en: Blood passes through your heart twice on every trip around your body. Why does a mammal need two circuits, and what happens when the pipes get blocked?
hook.kn: ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಸುತ್ತುವಾಗ ರಕ್ತ ಹೃದಯವನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಸ್ತನಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಸರ್ಕ್ಯೂಟ್ ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು? ನಾಳಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿಹೋದರೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Trace the pulmonary and systemic circulations
Explain neural and hormonal regulation of the heart
Describe hypertension, CAD, angina and heart failure

narration.en: Blood passes through your heart twice on every trip around your body. Why does a mammal need two circuits, and what happens when the pipes get blocked?
narration.kn: ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಸುತ್ತುವಾಗ ರಕ್ತ ಹೃದಯವನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಸ್ತನಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಸರ್ಕ್ಯೂಟ್ ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು? ನಾಳಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿಹೋದರೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: Blood pumped by the right ventricle enters the pulmonary artery, goes to the lungs and returns oxygenated through the pulmonary veins to the left atrium: this is pulmonary circulation. Oxygenated blood from the left ventricle enters the aorta and is carried by arteries, arterioles and capillaries to the tissues; deoxygenated blood returns through venules, veins and the vena cava to the right atrium: systemic circulation. Oxygenated and deoxygenated blood never mix. A special connection, the hepatic portal system, carries blood from the intestine to the liver through the hepatic portal vein before it reaches the systemic circulation. The coronary system supplies the heart muscle itself.
body.kn: ಬಲ ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿಯಿಂದ ಶ್ವಾಸಕೋಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಎಡ ಹೃತ್ಕರ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವುದು ಶ್ವಾಸಕೋಶ ಪರಿಚಲನೆ. ಎಡ ಹೃತ್ಕುಕ್ಷಿಯಿಂದ ದೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಬಲ ಹೃತ್ಕರ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವುದು ದೈಹಿಕ ಪರಿಚಲನೆ. ಯಕೃತ್ ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕ ಸಿರೆ ಕರುಳಿನಿಂದ ಯಕೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ರಕ್ತ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Coronary vessels: supply the heart muscle

Oxygenated blood from the left ventricle enters the aorta and is carried by arteries, arterioles and capillaries to the tissues; deoxygenated blood returns through venules, veins and the vena cava to the right atrium: systemic circulation. Oxygenated and deoxygenated blood never mix. A special connection, the hepatic portal system, carries blood from the intestine to the liver through the hepatic portal vein before it reaches the systemic circulation. The coronary system supplies the heart muscle itself.

body.en: Normal heart activity is auto-regulated by the nodal tissue, so the heart is myogenic. A special neural centre in the medulla oblongata can moderate it through the autonomic neural system. Sympathetic nerves increase the rate of heartbeat, the strength of ventricular contraction and so the cardiac output. Parasympathetic signals decrease the heart rate, the speed of conduction of the action potential and the cardiac output. Adrenal medullary hormones can also increase the cardiac output.
body.kn: ಹೃದಯದ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ. ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾದ ನರಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ನರವ್ಯೂಹದ ಮೂಲಕ ಅದನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. ಅನುವೇದನಾ ನರಗಳು ಹೃದಯ ಬಡಿತವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಪರಾನುವೇದನಾ ನರಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಡ್ರೀನಲ್ ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳೂ ಹೃದಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Normal heart activity is auto-regulated by the nodal tissue, so the heart is myogenic. A special neural centre in the medulla oblongata can moderate it through the autonomic neural system. Sympathetic nerves increase the rate of heartbeat, the strength of ventricular contraction and so the cardiac output. Parasympathetic signals decrease the heart rate, the speed of conduction of the action potential and the cardiac output. Adrenal medullary hormones can also increase the cardiac output.
narration.kn: ಹೃದಯದ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ. ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾದ ನರಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ನರವ್ಯೂಹದ ಮೂಲಕ ಅದನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. ಅನುವೇದನಾ ನರಗಳು ಹೃದಯ ಬಡಿತವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಪರಾನುವೇದನಾ ನರಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಡ್ರೀನಲ್ ಮೆಡುಲ್ಲಾ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳೂ ಹೃದಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Hypertension is blood pressure higher than normal (120/80 mm Hg); repeated readings of 140/90 or more indicate hypertension, which can harm the heart, brain and kidneys. Coronary artery disease (atherosclerosis) is the narrowing of the arteries supplying the heart muscle by deposits of calcium, fat, cholesterol and fibrous tissue. Angina pectoris is acute chest pain when not enough oxygen reaches the heart muscle. Heart failure means the heart is not pumping blood effectively enough; it is also called congestive heart failure because congestion of the lungs is a main symptom. It is not the same as cardiac arrest, when the heart stops beating, or a heart attack, when the heart muscle is suddenly damaged by inadequate blood supply.
body.kn: ರಕ್ತದೊತ್ತಡ 140/90 ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅಧಿಕ ರಕ್ತದೊತ್ತಡ. ಹೃದಯ ಧಮನಿ ರೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ, ಕೊಬ್ಬು, ಕೊಲೆಸ್ಟರಾಲ್ ಶೇಖರಣೆಯಿಂದ ಧಮನಿಗಳು ಕಿರಿದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಆಂಜೈನಾ ಎದೆನೋವು. ಹೃದಯ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ, ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ತಂಭನ ಮತ್ತು ಹೃದಯಾಘಾತ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ.

points.en: Heart failure ≠ cardiac arrest ≠ heart attack

problem.en: A patient's blood pressure readings on three days are 146/94, 150/92 and 142/90 mm Hg. Interpret the readings and name two organs at risk.

steps.en: Normal blood pressure is 120/80 mm Hg: 120 systolic (pumping) and 80 diastolic (resting).
All three readings are at or above 140/90 mm Hg, repeatedly.
Repeated readings of 140/90 or higher indicate hypertension, which can affect vital organs such as the heart, brain and kidneys.

answer.en: The patient has hypertension; the heart, brain and kidneys are at risk

points.en: Pulmonary circulation: RV → lungs → LA; systemic: LV → body → RA.

points.en: Hypertension is 140/90 mm Hg or higher; CAD narrows the coronary arteries.
